discoveries.title: test3 has no matched hand predictions
discoveries.body: The checkpoint lacks active/right/object heads, and test3 eval produced detection recall 0.0; hand_joint_l2_mm and hand_mesh_l2_mm are None on test3.

discoveries.body: train3 hand_joint_l2_mm is about 1,538,295 mm despite nonzero matching, indicating the direct_joints run does not produce usable global hand localization.

discoveries.title: test3 manifest repaired against v3.6 cache
discoveries.body: The initial test manifest used stale tracked_start=5. It was rewritten from the cache contract to starts 7, 11, and 9 before eval.

tasks_pending.summary: Do not scale this exact direct-hand-only checkpoint family as a solution; test split has no hand matches and train global hand coordinates explode.
Use this as evidence against the current direct_joints-only/detection-headless contract when choosing the next DT10 hand localization design.

caveats: This is a deterministic train3/test3 subset publish, not full 1000-entry cam836 eval.
The evaluated checkpoint intentionally lacks active/right/object heads; detection and hand-side metrics are therefore structurally limited.
Global gamma/orientation decomposition is unavailable because this checkpoint uses HAND_TARGET_MODE=direct_joints, not MANO gamma/phi heads.
Test RGB/3D hand visualization could not be generated because test3 predictions had no Hungarian assignment; the failure log is published.
